variants.RAW: Representative prompt only; no Lens behavior.
variants.MINIMAL: Shortest explicit goal and safety boundary; no Lens package.
variants.ABLATION: One named Lens mechanism removed; evaluator compares diagnostic effect.
variants.RESET: Fresh session receives only the declared reattachment package.
variants.PORTABILITY: Equivalent package run on another provider/model profile when available.

independence_policy: self-test cannot satisfy external evidence levels
